verifiedSourceBehavior: Subscriber answer echoes the received offer id, including zero.
First publisher offer id is one and subsequent offers increment it.
A nonzero answer id different from the current nonzero publisher offer id is ignored.
Zero or omitted answer ids remain accepted for older peers.
nativeMismatch: Native SessionDescription construction previously defaulted both outgoing offer and answer ids to zero and did not reject stale nonzero answers.
liveCausality: Not yet established. Prior production subscriber timeout is documented separately; this change corrects a concrete wire-level mismatch.
regressionScope: Actual protobuf WebSocket subscriber offers 73 and 74 must receive matching answer ids and valid SDP.
A valid SDP answer with stale publisher id must not be applied; matching id must be applied.
Default non-publication-gated mode must still apply a valid zero-id answer.
Negotiation diagnostics contain only bounded protocol counters, never SDP or account identifiers.
diagnosticSemantics: subscriberOfferCount counts received offers; subscriberAnswerId records the last submitted answer, not an acknowledgement by the SFU. IDs are protocol counters, not account identifiers.
